new_interesting_lines: **Sunstreaker got a buff to his Evasion ability. It's now a flat 30% Melee evasion buff. Before July 2023 he would never evade. But since then he Evades almost...too often, even against Thundercracker.....who doesn't land crits.

*[[Hot Rod]] - This... is a double-edge. On one hand there's the all-important Deceleration that removes the evasion, but the other lies the class bonus. But then again, Hot Rod doesn't inflict bleed debuffs...and has no answer to any of Sunstreaker's other abilities despite the class type advantages.

As you whittle his health down he'll become Unstoppable at three conditions, but otherwise it'll be relatively easy to dodge long-reach melee attacks and scratch him up. Be very careful of his Special 1 regardless of his health. Stay far away when he has it ready. Despite perfect dodging, being too close can allow him to gain the buffs anyway. Be on your guard

Ideally, you'd want to get Sunstreaker between 60%~41% health. This way you can constantly gain both State buffs at the same time. This meshes together well with Premium Model. Taking advantage of his power gain, you can land a SP2 and have a SP1 ready to go. This gives you 2 Melee Buffs, 2 Armor Buffs, 2 Evasion Buffs, and 4 more seconds on the Unstoppable buff!

If in Blemished State, gain Pristine State buffs for 6 seconds. If in neither state, gain both state buffs for 6 seconds. #'''Beautiful Attack''' - ''Sunstreaker has the looks and the skills to impress.'' #*Gain Pristine State Buffs and Blemished State Buffs for 6 seconds. ===Synergy Bonuses=== *[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Jet Judo''' - '''[[Jetfire]]''' - +4~6~7~16% Melee Buff against bots with an aerial alternate form. *[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Twin Engines''' - '''[[Sideswipe]]''' - Increase Power Gain by 2~3~4~8%. *{{Syn/In}} '''Optimus Maximus''' - '''[[Optimus Prime]]''' and [[Ironhide]], [[Prowl]], [[Mirage]] - Start the fight with 10~20~30~40% Power. Only applies if all Bots on the team have this Synergy. *{{Syn/In}} '''Magnificent Six''' - '''[[Jazz]]''' - When Knocked Down, 5~8~12~15% chance to gain +20% Special Damage for 5 seconds. Increases by 5% after each Knock Down. *[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - Acting as a beacon of leadership, all lower tier teammates gain +10% Attack Rating ==Strategy== ===Commander=== Meet Sunstreaker, the only Brawler who can evade and the only Bot who cannot inflict Debuffs! The two states of Sunstreaker are a double-sided coin, granting him either evade and armor or melee and an Unstoppable buff, with an empty state the middle of his health. With Pristine Armor he can passively absorb some damage at high health, then at low health actively gain emergency Armor with special 2 or 3. With Blemished Unstoppable he can go on the offensive racking two melee combos or escaping enemy locking him in. He can actively be Unstoppable at high health with Special 1 or 3, and then passively at low health. In the typical Brawler fashion Sunstreaker is a Melee and Armor kinda guy who can also... purify his own debuffs on ranged attacks? This only works on successful shots, and only a fifth the time, so it's not a reliable purifying skill compared to other Brawlers. Upgrading to the Premium Model grants him permanent buffs - both of which can stack up to a permanent 100% boost for either armor or melee! This is most useful in long fights. ===Opponent=== As you whittle his health down he'll become Unstoppable at three conditions, but otherwise it'll be relatively easy to doge long-reach melee attacks and scratch him up. ===Strong Match-ups=== ====Bots==== ''Sunstreaker’s Armor will make it harder for Warriors to land their big damage attacks, and Evades can help Sunstreaker avoid Bleed damage.'' *[[Bludgeon]] - No hit? No problem!... if Bludgeon can land the Metallikato, something Sunstreaker can avoid with evasion and armor. *[[Drift]] - In this duel of the sports cars, it's easily obvious who lands the most Bleeds against Sunstreaker will lose; he will easily best Drift in this case. *[[Cliffjumper]] relies on debuffs to make his Special Attacks more effective, something Sunstreaker can't inflict any which is a good counter. ==== Mods==== *Mod Name - sentence. ===Weak Match-ups=== ====Bots==== ''Sunstreaker relies on his Melee Buffs and Armor, which Tacticians can easily remove or ignore.'' *[[Hot Rod]] - This... is a double-edge. One one hand there's the all-important Deceleration that removes the evasion, but the other lies the class bonus. But then again, Hot Rod doesn't inflict bleed debuffs... *[[Cyclonus]] - You'd be thinking Sunstreaker will be appreciating himself more against this spawn of Unicron, but nope! Straight outta the edge of the galaxy, with a sword that pierces his armor and a Dark Field that can cancel the unstoppable buff, Sunstreaker has met his match. ====Mods==== * Mod Name - sentence. ===Recommended Modules=== *[[Repair Module]] - A repair right at 60% or 40% will re-activate the state buffs. *[[Security Module]] - puckers up Armor Buffs and extends expiring ones. ==Obtainment== *Vainglorious Crystal *Login calendar *5-Star Bot bundle == Gallery== File:Portrait sunstreak gs small.jpg File:Portrait sunstreak gs large.png ==Trivia== *Sunstreaker is based on the Universe 2008 Deluxe toy, a remodeling of his brother Sideswipe with the torso reversed. *He has a gun-sword from his ''Combiner Wars'' toy, an accessory carried over as a redeco of Breakdown. *His gun is an engine block, inspired by his ''Earthrise'' toy accessory. * Sunstreaker has two unique melee sequence Special Attacks but re-uses Drift's Special 3 animation. * The Magnificent Six Synergy he has is a pretty interesting homage, having seen a [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Magnificent_Six one-time appearance] in the British run of the Marvel ''The Transformers'' comics, complete with synergy between [[Jazz]], [[Prowl]] and [[Wheeljack]]. == [[Version History|Updates]]== *Add update to Bot here **Add details ==References== ==External Links== [[Category:Bots]] [[Category:Autobot]] [[Category:Generation 1]] [[Category:G1]] [[Category:Generation 1 Autobots]] [[Category:Brawler]]
